nikunj.en:
Every single large company with data walls realizing it’s time to go headless (or essentially die)..

It’s the right call too since the market/usage for agents will be 100x larger than humans. 

If you gatekeep your systems for humans, you’ll most likely be 100x less valuable!
nikunj.zh:
每一个拥有数据墙的大公司都意识到是时候去无头（或者本质上消亡）了。

这也是正确的选择，因为代理的市场/使用量将比人类大 100 倍。 

如果你为人类把守你的系统，你的价值很可能会降低 100 倍！
